title: Calibrate companion mascot dark-mode medallion luminance and backdrop

spec.problem: After WEB-435 framed BattleBotAvatar variant=companion as a dark-mode circular disc with dark:brightness-[0.80] dark:contrast-[1.06] dark:saturate-[1.12], live production verification shows the disc interior still renders glaring light silver-gray because the baked #E0E0E0 Rive artboard sits at 0.7027 (>0.5) after brightness(0.80), so contrast(1.06) pushes it up to #b6b6b6 (relative luminance 0.4695, 8.83:1 jump over #0f172a paper — more than double the 0.22 ceiling).

acceptance.text: AC1: Dark-scoped companion canvas filter and disc backdrop/vignette recalibrated so #E0E0E0 artboard rendered luminance is <= 0.22 (measured 0.1536 direct / 0.1289 at 90% resting opacity) while #EC5264 coral hue stays in red-coral family (353.0 deg, dH=0.0 deg) and cream face features stay distinguishable; light mode and arena/card variants remain untouched.
AC2: WEB-435/WEB-437 component and contrast-calibration regression tests pin the calibrated classes, dark-only vignette, and W3C Filter Effects luminance/hue bounds.
AC3: pnpm quality verify passes, WEB-437 closes VERIFIED via harness, and git status contains only owned files.

spec.expected_behavior: In dark mode only, BattleBotAvatar variant=companion applies dark:brightness-[0.50] dark:contrast-[1.18] dark:saturate-[1.28] over a dark:bg-paper dark:ring-border clipped disc with a dark-only inset vignette overlay (hidden dark:block), bringing the #E0E0E0 artboard to #6d6d6d (L=0.1536 <= 0.22 direct, 0.1289 at 90% resting opacity) while preserving exact coral-red #EC5264 hue (353.0 deg, dH=0.0 deg, S=74.6%, no channel clipping) and face/cream distinguishability, with light mode and arena/card variants pixel-identical.
spec.observed_behavior: In dark mode, BattleBotAvatar variant=companion applies dark:brightness-[0.80] dark:contrast-[1.06] dark:saturate-[1.12] over a dark:bg-surface dark:ring-border-hover disc, rendering the baked #E0E0E0 artboard at #b6b6b6 (L=0.4695 direct, 0.3831 at 90% resting opacity), which still reads as a bright silver-gray glare disc against the dark navy page.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert apps/web/app/_components/battle-bot-avatar.tsx and its WEB-437 test updates; no API, DB, admin, deploy, or .riv asset files are modified.

classification.rationale: Dark-mode visual calibration of BattleBotAvatar companion variant in apps/web; no API, database, admin, or domain logic changes.
